app.name: WiiTube
app.long_description:
Search and watch YouTube and Shorts directly on the Wii, with no PC or proxy server.
Browsing: point with the Wii Remote or use the D-Pad. A selects, B goes Home, + opens search, 1 changes the default quality (480p), HOME exits. The rail on the left has Home, Shorts and Search; the WiiTube logo goes Home. Home's "For you" shows YouTube's recommendations for what you watched. Drag the scrollbar on the right with A (or use the Nunchuk stick); more videos load as you scroll. Videos: A pauses, Left/Right (or the Nunchuk stick) skip 10 seconds, point at the progress bar and press A to jump, 1 turns captions on/off, 2 opens settings (quality, captions, audio track), +/- or Up/Down change the volume, B goes back. Shorts: Up/Down go to the previous/next Short in YouTube's Shorts feed.
A log is written to sd:/apps/wiitube/wiitube.log.
